title: Application database
intro: Keep SQLite for a simple installation, or move application data to MySQL.
sqliteHint: Stored locally. No database server is required.
botPreserved: Bot data already uses MySQL and will remain in its current database.
managed: Only an administrator can change the application database.
unavailable: Database status is unavailable. Your inputs are kept; try again.
connectionHint: Test the connection, then review what will move before starting.
passwordHint: Used for this connection only. Connection details are never saved in browser storage.
tlsHint: Use a trusted certificate for remote databases.
caFile: CA certificate file on the server (optional)
planHint: Source data will be backed up. Writes pause during migration, and the application must restart to use the new database.
notReadyHint: The application must support every data area before migration can begin. Connection testing is still available.
issueFallback: A database check needs attention. Review administrator diagnostics.
runningHint: Keep this page open, or return here to check progress.
unknown: The submission could not be confirmed. Checking the original request before allowing another migration.
noReceipt: No receipt is available yet. Check again before starting another migration.
recoveryUnavailable: This browser cannot retain a recovery token. Enable session storage before starting migration.
tokenMissing: This migration was started elsewhere. Its recovery controls are available in the browser that started it.
completeHint: Data has been verified and the application is using the selected database.
restartHint: Data is ready. Waiting for the application to restart; status will reconnect automatically.
failedHint: Migration stopped. Your source data and this operation’s recovery record are retained.
canceledHint: Migration was canceled. The source database remains selected.
setupHint: SQLite is ready to use. You can configure MySQL now or migrate later in Storage and logs.
invalidDatabaseConfiguration: Check the connection fields and try again.
databaseUnavailable: The database service is temporarily unavailable.
unsupportedDatabaseServer: This database server version is not supported.
unsupportedMigrationSource: Moving an application that already uses MySQL is not supported yet. Keep the current database selected.
certificateUnavailable: The server could not read the CA certificate file.
connectionFailed: Could not connect. Check the address, credentials and TLS settings.
incompleteDatabaseBackend: Some application data areas are not ready for migration.
databaseSchemaDrift: Existing target tables need administrator review.
migrationAlreadyRunning: A migration is already running. Check its status here.
migrationPlanExpired: This plan expired. Review migration again; your inputs are kept.
migrationTargetAlreadyOwned: The target already contains application data. Choose an empty target or review its existing migration.
migrationSourceChanged: Source data changed. Prepare a new verified migration plan.
migrationVerificationFailed: Data verification did not pass. The source database has been kept.
migrationRecordTooLarge: A stored record exceeds the supported migration size. Administrator support is required.
migrationPacketLimitTooSmall: The target server packet limit is too small for this data.
restartUnavailable: Automatic restart is unavailable. An administrator must restart the application.
operationNotFound: No migration receipt is available yet. Check status again.
operationTokenInvalid: This recovery token cannot access the migration. Use the browser that started it.
migrationAlreadyActivated: The new database is already selected. Check the current status.
cancelRequiresAdministrator: An administrator must cancel this migration.
rollbackRequiresMigration: Returning to SQLite requires a separate verified migration.
botDatabaseTargetMismatch: Bot data uses a different MySQL target and must be preserved.
migrationFailed: Migration stopped. Check the details and available recovery actions.
filesHint: File locations and log retention remain managed by this instance’s configuration.
scopeHint: Document files, attachments and engine history keep their existing storage.
maintenanceHint: The application is moving its database. Normal access will return when it is ready.
maintenancePrivate: To view migration details or recovery controls, use the browser that started the migration.
maintenanceFailed: Migration needs administrator attention. Use the browser that started it to recover.
reconnecting: Waiting for normal access to return…
hostRecoveryArguments: Use absolute --state-root and --output paths and an explicit loopback IP --url. Supported locales: en, zh-CN, zh-HK, zh-TW.
hostRecoveryPrivateFile: Recovery requires regular 0600 files in private state and output directories. Check the paths and permissions.
hostRecoveryOperationChanged: The maintenance operation changed. Keep the saved capability and check the selected state volume and instance.
hostRecoveryUnconfirmed: The recovery response could not be confirmed. Keep the output file and rerun the same command with the same --output.
hostRecoveryFailed: Host recovery could not complete. Keep the original state and private recovery file for administrator diagnosis.
hostRecoverySaved: Recovery capability saved to {path}. Keep this file private.
hostRecoveryRetryQueued: Retry requested for the original operation. Check its maintenance status.
hostRecoveryHelp:
Usage: bun src/server/database/recover.ts --state-root /absolute/state --url http://127.0.0.1:PORT --output /absolute/private/recovery.json [--retry] [--locale en|zh-CN|zh-HK|zh-TW]
Only loopback IP addresses are accepted. Capability values are saved only to --output and are never printed. Reuse the same output file after an unknown response.
